pages.text: Find bauxite in the hills and smelt it into aluminium: the light metal every tank, panel and rocket is made of.
Take field samples with a Sample Kit and analyse them in a Research Lab. Each world reveals different technologies.
Old research sites hide tech disks. The abandoned observatories on Earth still hold the first rocketry data.
Design a rocket, reach orbit, land on the Moon and come home safely. Then keep going.
